# Ny indikator 3

**Ny indikator 3** is a revised quality indicator from the Danish ADHD database, developed to replace the previous [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]] as part of a broader overhaul of the database's monitoring metrics for ADHD assessment in children and young people. It measures the proportion of 0-17-year-olds for whom a systematic review of ADHD symptoms has been carried out, together with a broad psychopathological screening interview for any psychiatric comorbidity [^src1].

The indicator emerged from a steering group review process ("Styregruppen") that concluded the old Indikator 3 no longer reflected current clinical practice well enough, and split it into two new indicators with new definitions [^src2]. Ny Indikator 3 is explicitly aligned with the DMPG guideline for ADHD assessment ("DMPG-retningslinjen for ADHD-udredningen"), meaning its criteria are meant to mirror recommended clinical standards rather than a stricter research-grade protocol [^src3].

A key methodological point behind the indicator is that a fully manualized diagnostic interview — such as K-SADS or PSE — is not considered necessary in every ADHD assessment [^src1]. Instead, in many cases a systematic review of ADHD symptoms combined with a broad screening interview for possible psychiatric comorbidity is deemed sufficient [^src1]. This reflects a deliberate move by the steering group toward a graduated model of assessment: together with its sibling measure, [[ny-indikator-2b|Ny indikator 2b]], the new indicators are designed to allow clinicians to do more in complex cases and less in simpler ones [^src1]. The stated hope is that, by better matching actual clinical practice, the new indicators will lead to improved goal achievement compared to the old ones [^src1].

Within the broader documentation, Ny indikator 3 sits alongside Ny indikator 2b as one of the two revised measures introduced in response to criticism of the database's original Indikator 2b and Indikator 3, which had shown substantial underachievement of the 90% development target — with national compliance rates of only 51% and 27% respectively, and notable regional variation (Region Midtjylland improving, Region Syddanmark declining), according to the surrounding chunk context covering the reporting period 01.04.2024-31.03.2025. Ny indikator 3 is described as due to be implemented within the coming months [^src1].

## Mentions

- Page 22: "Ny indikator 3 Andelen af 0-17-årige hvor der er foretaget systematisk gennemgang af ADHD-symptomer samt bredt psykopatologisk screeningsinterview af eventuel psykiatrisk komorbiditet." [^src1]
- Page 22: "Det vurderes ikke nødvendigt med et manualiseret diagnostisk interview (eks K-SADS eller PSE) i alle ADHD-udredninger." [^src1]

## Relationships

- **ny-indikator-3** *replaces* **indikator-3**
  Evidence: "Styregruppen har arbejdet med revision af denne indikator, som bliver delt i to nye indikator med nye definitioner" (Page 22) [^src2]
- **ny-indikator-3** *aligns-with* **dmpg-guideline-adhd-children-youth**
  Evidence: "Denne nye indikator læner sig ligeledes op ad DMPG-retningslinjen for ADHD-udredningen" (Page 22) [^src3]

## Claims

**Methodological**
- Ny Indikator 3 måler andelen af 0-17-årige hvor der er foretaget systematisk gennemgang af ADHD-symptomer samt bredt psykopatologisk screeningsinterview af eventuel psykiatrisk komorbiditet[^src1] (ny-indikator-3)

**Clinical-standard**
- Det vurderes ikke nødvendigt med et manualiseret diagnostisk interview (eks K-SADS eller PSE) i alle ADHD-udredninger[^src1] (ny-indikator-3)
- I mange sager er det sufficient med en systematisk gennemgang af ADHD-symptomer og et bredt screeningsinterview ift. evt. psykiatrisk komorbiditet[^src1] (ny-indikator-3)

**Clinical-rationale**
- De nye indikatorer giver mulighed for at graduere indsatserne i udredningsforløbene således at man i mere komplekse sager kan gøre mere og i mindre komplekse sager mindre[^src1] (ny-indikator-2b, ny-indikator-3)
- De nye indikatorer afspejler i højere grad den aktuelle kliniske praksis, hvilket forhåbentlig vil medføre bedre målopfyldelse[^src1] (ny-indikator-2b, ny-indikator-3)
